profile.name: Valeo SE
profile.summary: Valeo SE, a technology company, designs, produces, and sells products and systems for the automotive markets in France, other European countries, Africa, North America, South America, and Asia. It operates through three segments: Power, Brain, and Light. The Power segment offers automotive thermal systems, including electric vehicle (EV) cooling systems, which comprise XL plate liquid coolers, high performance chillers, electrically driven compressors, front end cooling modules, and air intake modules; EV range extension, which includes heat pump systems, flexheater, and ultra-thin HVAC; thermal management of EV battery systems comprising battery coolers and composite battery casing. This segment also develops thermal comfort solutions, such as smart cocoon demo car, Valeo odor free, air-conditioning loop, active grille shutter, and HVAC unit; and air quality systems, which include PM sensor, Cabin filt'air range, and two-vane rotary compressors, as well as UV air purifiers for public transport. The Brain segment offers driving assistance systems that design ultrasonic sensors, radars, and cameras, including Valeo Scala Lidar, Valeo 360VUE, Park4U, an automated parking system, Valeo Xtravue trailer, front cameras, and domain controllers; intuitive controls, such as heads-up display, interior cocoon, display, and steering wheel hub; connectivity solutions, which include vehicle telematics systems; and access solution such as, phone as key, and passive entry passive start systems. The Light segment provides lighting system solutions, such as picturebeam moonlighic, 360° light projection on the ground, LED rear lighting, front and rear fascias, non-blinding road beams; and wiper systems including, sensor cleaning systems, aquablade, and remote clean4U. The company also offers aftermarket services, original equipment spares, and spare parts and services. The company was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
profile.summary_fr: Valeo SE, une société de technologie, conçoit, produit et vend des produits et des systèmes pour les marchés automobiles en France, dans d'autres pays européens, en Afrique, en Amérique du Nord, en Amérique du Sud et en Asie. Il opère à travers trois segments: le pouvoir, le cerveau et la lumière. Le segment Power propose des systèmes thermiques automobiles, y compris des systèmes de refroidissement de véhicules électriques (VE), qui comprennent des refroidisseurs de liquide à plaques XL, des refroidisseurs haute performance, des compresseurs à entraînement électrique, des modules de refroidissement avant et des modules d'admission d'air; extension de la gamme EV, qui comprend des systèmes de pompe à chaleur, de flexheater et de CVC ultra-mince; gestion thermique des systèmes de batterie EV comprenant des refroidisseurs de batterie et un boîtier de batterie composite.
